Title: Verify the AI Robot Fleet HELIOS's work
Description: Descend into the elevator shaft and inspect the robots' construction work.
GameplayMeaning: Guides the player from submarine to shaft before the crash

Title: SURVIVE
Description: Stay alive after the elevator crash and establish a path out of immediate danger.

Title: DISCOVER WHAT THIS PLACE IS
Description: Scan structures, materials, and anomalies to understand the impossible cavern.

Title: MAKE THE MACHINE ANSWER
Description: Learn to operate ancient systems and make alien technology respond.

Title: BUILD A WAY OUT
Description: Fabricate devices from discovered alien technology and construct a return mechanism.

Title: OPEN THE RIFT
Description: Activate a player-built rift/portal back to the surface.
